UpdateSourceData:
#!/bin/bash
# AMP update: MySQL 8.4 LTS, AzerothCore source + modules, build, client data.
# Args: <repo> <branch> <module repos, space/comma separated> <build jobs, 0 = all cores>
set -eo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")"
repo=$1 branch=$2 modules=$3 jobs=${4:-0}
mkdir -p mysql server/data

# AzerothCore needs MySQL (MariaDB is unsupported); private copy, latest 8.4 LTS patch.
want=$(wget -qO- https://endoflife.date/api/v1/products/mysql/releases/8.4 | jq -r .result.latest.name || true)
if [[ $want =~ ^8\.4\.[0-9]+$ && $want != "$(cat mysql/.amp-version 2>/dev/null)" ]]; then
    echo "Downloading MySQL $want"
    wget -qO- "https://cdn.mysql.com/Downloads/MySQL-8.4/mysql-$want-linux-glibc2.28-$(uname -m)-minimal.tar.xz" | tar -xJ -C mysql --strip-components=1
    echo "$want" > mysql/.amp-version
elif [[ ! -x mysql/bin/mysqld ]]; then
    echo "Could not determine the latest MySQL 8.4 release"; exit 1
fi

echo "Fetching $repo ($branch)"
if [[ -d source/.git ]]; then
    git -C source remote set-url origin "$repo"
    git -C source fetch --depth 1 origin "$branch"
    git -C source reset --hard FETCH_HEAD
else
    git clone --depth 1 --branch "$branch" "$repo" source
fi
for m in ${modules//,/ }; do
    d=source/modules/$(basename "$m" .git)
    echo "Fetching module $m"
    if [[ -d $d/.git ]]; then
        git -C "$d" fetch --depth 1 origin && git -C "$d" reset --hard FETCH_HEAD
    else
        git clone --depth 1 "$m" "$d"
    fi
done

(( jobs > 0 )) || jobs=$(nproc)
cmake -S source -B build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX="$PWD/server" \
    -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=clang -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=clang++ -DAPPS_BUILD=all -DTOOLS_BUILD=db-only \
    -DSCRIPTS=static -DMODULES=static -DWITH_WARNINGS=0 \
    -DMYSQL_INCLUDE_DIR="$PWD/mysql/include" -DMYSQL_LIBRARY="$PWD/mysql/lib/libmysqlclient.so"
echo "Building with $jobs jobs (the first build takes a long time)"
cmake --build build -j "$jobs"
cmake --install build >/dev/null

# Client data (dbc, maps, vmaps, mmaps, Cameras) from the release AzerothCore's installer uses.
rel=$(wget -qO- https://api.github.com/repos/wowgaming/client-data/releases/latest || true)
tag=$(jq -r '.tag_name // empty' <<<"$rel" 2>/dev/null || true)
url=$(jq -r '.assets[]? | select(.name == "Data.zip") | .browser_download_url' <<<"$rel" 2>/dev/null || true)
if [[ -n $url && $tag != "$(cat server/data/.amp-version 2>/dev/null)" ]]; then
    echo "Downloading client data $tag (about 1.2 GB)"
    wget -q -O data.zip "$url"
    rm -rf server/data/{Cameras,dbc,maps,mmaps,vmaps}
    unzip -q -o data.zip -d server/data
    rm -f data.zip
    echo "$tag" > server/data/.amp-version
elif [[ ! -d server/data/dbc ]]; then
    echo "Could not find the client data release"; exit 1
fi
echo "AzerothCore update complete"
